rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for rape, including the act described in legal and everyday contexts.

example.english: The police are already following up on this rape case.
example.traditional: 呢宗強姦案已經交咗畀警方跟進。
example.jyutping: ne1 zung1 koeng4 gaan1 on3 ji5 ging1 gaau1 zo2 bei2 ging2 fong1 gan1 zeon3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese verb for forcing sexual activity on someone without consent.

example.english: That man allegedly committed rape against the girl and has been arrested by the police.
example.traditional: 嗰個男人涉嫌強姦嗰個女仔，已經畀警方拉咗。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 naam4 jan2 sip3 jim4 koeng4 gaan1 go2 go3 neoi5 zai2 ji5 ging1 bei2 ging2 fong1 laai1 zo2
